function: Excluded for system: single-antenna satellite-to-ground-station links without RIS in an over-the-air federated learning power-control work (area 7); scalar channel coefficient (p. 2).
notes: Excluded, reason system (p. 2). OPCO is a heuristic power search for over-the-air aggregation in a LEO satellite backbone: area 7 (it also fits area 6, but 7 wins in the order 7, 4, 6). The learned element is the federated model (ResNet9 on CIFAR10, p. 4), so no_learning does not apply; the function is area 7 power control of the aggregation, so function passes. Each satellite link has one scalar coefficient: p. 2: "is the channel coefficient for the transmission" from satellite i to the GS, drawn as CSCG with unit variance. The text never mentions antennas, arrays, MIMO, beams or RIS, and Fig. 1 (p. 3) shows none; the single antenna is inferred from this scalar model, not stated in words. The single-antenna allowance covers OTFS and NTN works (areas 4 and 6); this work is assigned area 7, so the reviewer may want to confirm that reading, as the links are satellite links.
